verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly points to bulk capability. The official CLI exposes data commands such as `sf data query`, which retrieves many records at once. The vendor also cites generic APIs and agents that 'autonomously handle repetitive tasks.' Nothing documents bulk writes (mass update, upsert, delete or import) across many records. Missing for 10: documented bulk create/update/delete operations (e.g. Bulk API or CLI bulk upsert/delete), UI mass-action support, agent-driven batch operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
